verdict.rationale: Git cloning is a fair question for a Unix-like terminal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions git, lg2, or cloning repositories over HTTPS, SSH, or the Git protocol. The listed ios_system commands and pkg packages (zip, unzip, xz, ffmpeg, nslookup, whois, python3, lua) do not include any Git client.

support.subject: As a developer, I can clone Git repositories over HTTPS, SSH, or the Git protocol
